title: Joint AST–ALT information did not establish incremental cognitive-score prediction across NHANES cycles
abstract: Among 1170 NHANES2011–12 training and 1391 NHANES2013–14 test participants aged60+, a log-AST×log-ALT interaction changed MEC-weighted DSST mean squared error from 164.527790 to 164.495284. Baseline-minus-augmented MSE was 0.032506 (target-PSU bootstrap95%CI -0.094995 to 0.166605); incremental benefit was not established.
